basic_info.description: Timeless Victorian architecture combines with modern amenities in this beautiful home with private outdoor space and parking in a stellar location. A private entrance opens onto a long hallway and comfortable living room with tall windows and a beautifully preserved period fireplace. Classic details include soaring ceilings, decorative moldings and refinished wood floors. The gracious formal dining room is flooded with light and has a beautiful inlaid tile decorative fireplace. Adjacent to the dining room is the updated eat-in kitchen with stainless appliances and a large pantry. Enjoy morning coffee or evening wine on the private, sunny east facing deck, which leads down to a verdant and whimsical shared garden. The two generously sized bedrooms have ample closet space and the bathroom has been updated with a double-headed walk-in shower.  There is a large garage with storage and 1-car tandem parking. Tenancy in Common in a 2-unit building that is soon eligible for fast track condo conversion. Fabulous central location with 99 WalkScore. Close to 4 parks, including dog-friendly Duboce Park. Walk to the Castro, Duboce Triangle, Hayes Valley, Divisadero Street and Upper Haight restaurants, coffee shops and amenities. Excellent access to public transportation. This one has it all!
